skill.displayName: 企业所得税纳税调整核对（免费版）

llm.summary: The free checker itself is local and purpose-aligned, but its documentation tells agents how to run an unpinned remote installer and proceed into a paid skill/payment installation flow.

dimensions.detail: The shipped runtime code only reads an input file and runs local Node logic with no network APIs found, which is proportionate for the checker. The documented upgrade path is not similarly contained because it can execute remote code and alter the user's installed skill environment.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact instructs running `npx -y @alipay/agent-payment@latest install`, which downloads and executes a mutable package without pinning, integrity verification, or an included reviewed payload.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md asks the user to copy agent-facing instructions that authorize installing dependencies, running SkillPay onboarding, reading a newly installed SKILL.md, and purchasing/installing a specific product. That is broader than ordinary use of the free checker.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, credential access, or privilege escalation appears in the included executable files. However, the documented upgrade flow installs additional onboarding and product skills, creating cross-session changes outside this reviewed artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core purpose is coherent: a local Chinese enterprise income tax adjustment-table checker that reads user-provided input and produces deterministic findings. The concern is the optional paid-upgrade section, which expands from local checking into dependency installation, skill installation, and purchase flow.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Use the included free checker only as a local review aid for Chinese enterprise income tax adjustment tables. Do not let an agent run the paid-upgrade `npx ... @latest` command or follow newly installed SkillPay onboarding instructions unless you independently verify the package source, version, installer behavior, payment destination, and what new skills will be installed.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: Downgraded: the referenced local `scripts/run.mjs` was present and fully inspected; it imports only Node standard modules, reads the chosen input file, loads the local engine, and prints results.
[SQP-3] expected: Accepted only as a usability/localization note: the skill and outputs are predominantly Chinese, but the tax form context is PRC/Chinese-language specific and this is not a security concern by itself.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted in context: the free skill advertises no payment/no network, while the documentation later provides operational agent instructions for a paid SkillPay purchase and installation path outside the local free runtime.
[RP1] unexpected: Accepted: the upgrade instructions use an unpinned `@latest` npx installer and delegate to a newly installed onboarding skill that is not included in the reviewed artifact.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Partly accepted: the engine correctly lists withheld checks, but the runtime disclaimer also mentions reference limit rates that the free engine does not actually execute, which can overstate checking coverage in a tax-compliance context.
[T08] unexpected: Accepted: the SARIF finding matches artifact evidence in SKILL.md lines 83-88 for mutable third-party package execution through npx during the paid-upgrade path.
